rationale: A clean single-lever ablation of the archive winner (cash-based rather than accrual-based validation of the intangible leg) that is internally consistent and directionally coherent, though it is close to a mechanical recombination of two well-known published effects (cash-based operating profitability and R&D intensity) and risks being only a marginal variant of the existing gen-0 result.

The intangible leg double-counts advertising (xad is a component of xsga in Compustat), and SG&A-intensity-as-organization-capital is a directly published anomaly (Eisfeldt–Papanikolaou), so the conjunction rests on a mis-specified input plus a rediscovered core variable even though the coverage argument is valid.

The two legs are mechanically inversely related — high (xrd+xad)/sale directly inflates the denominator of profit-per-cumulative-intangible-dollar — so the MIN conjunction selects a thin, internally contradictory intersection, and the efficiency leg substantially replicates the archive's already-weak ReturnOnTotalIntangibleCapital.

This is a genuine, well-diagnosed repair of a documented FMB-versus-portfolio disagreement with a materially different construction (raw-difference wedge ranked jointly, rather than the z-score difference), though the reviewer should verify that gating on oiadp/at — which enters the wedge with a negative sign — does not simply hollow out the long tail.

The expression does not compute what the hypothesis claims — oiadp+dp is just EBITDA (≈oibdp) and dp is dominated by tangible depreciation, so no amortization-specific drag is isolated — and the signed-product form structurally shorts profitable low-intangible firms, an implication the hypothesis never asserts, while replicating the exact failed form of the archive's GoodwillCashValidation.

The profitability information-ratio leg gives a defensibly distinct risk-misperception mechanism and the winsorization handles the small-VOL tail, but it is the third single-leg swap of the same gen-0 conjunction in this batch and the stability leg conflates level with volatility (a known earnings-volatility anomaly), so the incremental lesson is modest.
